column3: Kill $1oa Gloomrise Hatchlings and $2oa Gloomrise Soldiers.
column4: There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.\r\n\r\nIt would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.

column3: Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
column4:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

column3: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
column4: $n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.\r\n\r\nI've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

column3: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.
column4: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.

column3: Speak with Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
column4: Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.\r\n\r\nI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

column3: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
column4: Bibbly thinks he is the only goblin in Desolace who knows how to make money.  Well, the only caravan brave enough to travel these parts relies on me.  Ever since I learned how to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with my kodo kombobulator, the caravan owner Cork, Rigger, and I entered a partnership.$B$BTake the kombobulator and use it on any ancient, aged, or dying kodos; it will jolt the beast into a tamed kodo and force it to follow you.  Once you have a kodo tamed, bring it back to me.

column3: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
column4: <The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.\r\n\r\nThere are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>

column3: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
column4: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them.  We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.$B$BIf you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram.  After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.

column3: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
column4: During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.$B$BThere are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.$B$BTo test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.

column3: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
column4: You have the look of a fisherman, $c! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?$B$BUp north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
